name: prompt-first-bench
description: D1 像素风视频「Clawd 的学习 / 升级」v2.0 (arena) + prompt-first 流程调研仓库

scripts.build: node src/check_overlap_arena.js && node src/render_learning_arena.js && node scripts/build_audio_arena.js --mux
scripts.error:build: node src/check_overlap_error.js && node src/render_error_arena.js && node scripts/build_audio_error.js --mux
scripts.build:learning:v2: node src/check_overlap_learning_v2.js && node src/render_learning_arena_v2.js && node scripts/build_audio_learning_v2.js --mux && node scripts/verify_av_sync_v2.js learning && node scripts/verify_media_v2.js learning
scripts.build:upgrade:v2: node src/check_overlap_upgrade_v2.js && node src/render_upgrade_arena_v2.js && node scripts/build_audio_upgrade_v2.js --mux && node scripts/verify_av_sync_v2.js upgrade && node scripts/verify_media_v2.js upgrade
scripts.verify:v2: node scripts/verify_av_sync_v2.js learning && node scripts/verify_av_sync_v2.js upgrade && node scripts/verify_media_v2.js all
scripts.check:story: npm run check:companion:v11 && npm run check:reboot && npm run check:dialogue && npm run check:farewell
scripts.build:companion:v11: node src/check_overlap_companion_v11.js && node src/render_companion_arena_v11.js && node scripts/build_audio_companion_v11.js --mux
scripts.build:reboot: node src/check_overlap_reboot.js && node src/render_reboot_arena.js && node scripts/build_audio_reboot.js --mux
scripts.build:dialogue: node src/check_overlap_dialogue.js && node src/render_dialogue_arena.js && node scripts/build_audio_dialogue.js --mux
scripts.build:farewell: node src/check_overlap_farewell.js && node src/render_farewell_arena.js && node scripts/build_audio_farewell.js --mux
scripts.build:story: npm run build:companion:v11 && npm run build:reboot && npm run build:dialogue && npm run build:farewell && npm run verify:story
